fields.zone: The physical area or room where the record applies.
fields.role: The job title or personnel classification.
fields.authorisation: Whether a specific role is authorized for access.
fields.station: The identifier of the industrial station or asset.
fields.rule: The narrative statement of a operational rule or constraint.
fields.asset: The specific piece of equipment or station being monitored.
fields.sensor: The identifier of the sensor measuring a value.
fields.unit: The unit of measurement for the sensor value.
fields.nominal: The target or normal operating value range.
fields.critical_response: The required action when a critical threshold is breached.
fields.action: The required corrective action or maintenance task.
fields.depends_on: The station or system that the current asset depends upon.
fields.downstream_effect: The impact of a fault on subsequent stations or processes.
fields.trigger: The specific condition or event that activates a rule.
fields.priority: The criticality or priority level of the record.
fields.max_persons: The maximum number of people allowed in a zone.
fields.enforcement: The rules governing how limits are enforced or monitored.
fields.anomaly_type: The classification of the detected anomaly.
fields.definition: The technical definition of an anomaly type.
fields.detection_criterion: The mathematical or logical criterion for detecting an anomaly.
fields.ontology_class: The formal classification of the event in the system ontology.
fields.max_ack_warning_min: The maximum allowed time to acknowledge a warning.
fields.max_ack_critical_min: The maximum allowed time to acknowledge a critical alarm.
fields.requirement: A mandatory operational or security requirement.
fields.pattern: The causal chain or pattern of events across stations.
fields.primary_fault: The root cause of the failure.
fields.secondary_effect: The resulting symptoms or side effects of a primary fault.
fields.resolution: The step-by-step procedure to resolve the issue.
fields.condition: The prose stating when a rule applies.
fields.station_dependencies: The overall flow or sequence of station dependencies.
fields.fault_propagation: The logic of how faults move through the system.
fields.criterion: The general basis for a decision or requirement.
fields.threshold_hierarchy: The logical ordering of threshold levels.

categories.AccessConstraint: Rules regarding personnel access and authorization.
categories.StaticLimit: Fixed threshold values and operating ranges.
categories.TriggeredResponse: Actions taken in response to a specific trigger.
categories.StationDependency: Relationships and flows between different stations.
categories.CorrectiveProcedure: Steps to resolve a fault or issue.
categories.FaultPropagationRule: Rules on how faults spread through the system.
categories.DataRequirement: Requirements for data logging or KG nodes.
